newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 4.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Dec 4.

text.p: The following events are scheduled to take place in and around Parliament on Wednesday.
- Trade and Industry questions at 1430 GMT.
- Remaining stages of the Firearms (Amendment) Bill from 1530 GMT.
- Home Affairs Committee, inquiring into prison service, hears from Derek Lewis, its sacked former director. 1615 GMT
- Public Service Committee hears from Sir Len Peach, Commissioner for Public Appointments. 1545 GMT
- People entitled to British pensions who live in Canada and elsewhere protest to Social Services Committee at their treatment by Britain, 1600 GMT.
- OFTEL chairman Don Cruickshank gives evidence to Trade and Industry Select Committee on energy regulation. 1100 GMT
- Press gallery lunch with television interviewer Sir David Frost. 1300 GMT
